question: Can a maintainer accept the older standalone six-process proof after the conflict-resolution move, or should the contributor provide the same proof on the current exact head before the protected review gate is cleared?
rationale: The runtime code was relocated during the latest rebase, so the previous live proof is strong but not exact-head evidence; only a maintainer can waive that evidence boundary under the protected label state.

options.title: Require current-head proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript of six concurrent initializers succeeding against the current exact head, then resume normal merge gating.

options.title: Accept continuity evidence
options.body: Explicitly accept that the relocation preserved the already-proven implementation and clear the protected human-review gate without another standalone run.

recommendation.title: Require current-head proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript of six concurrent initializers succeeding against the current exact head, then resume normal merge gating.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the only identified repository member with recent, item-specific review and guarded-lane context.
